== Identity ruling, 24 November 2026 ==
Bill ruled on 24 November 2026 that the 2000–2004 Atlanta player (DeckTech "Alpha Blue" / "Shadow 29", forum Shadow 29) and John "puck71" Anderson (1982–2018, Minnesota and North Dakota) are treated as one person until there is more evidence: they may be two people, but John Anderson is a common name and nothing yet justifies a split. The question is listed on [[Mysteries#John Anderson of Atlanta and John Anderson of Minnesota: one person or two?|Mysteries: John Anderson of Atlanta and John Anderson of Minnesota: one person or two?]] for others to help settle. The "Possibly faulty data" entry of 23 November 2026 above stays as the record of the open question; the article now carries a Mystery flag in its lead.

=== Possibly faulty data ===
* An earlier gap list read post 39292 as saying he organized the T & T Toys tournaments with the "ATL Crew". It does not: it is a reply offering a ride, with his signature. The tournament facts come from posts 33712, 39429, 45358 and 45800, which announce or schedule the events; only the 2003 State Championship listing gives him a role word (TD).
* In post 47308 his Senate record lists "GenCon 2k3", "Day 1" and "GA States". The post does not say which Day 1, so the article quotes it as written. GA States is read as the 22 May 2004 event: the post is from June 2004 and post 51876 says he played it.
* Post 33712 (September 2003) was last edited by its author on 2 June 2004; the capture shows the edited text.

=== Missing data ===
* His finish and Dark Side deck at the 2004 Georgia State Championship are not in the posts.
